entities.summary: Kevin Gravel is an American professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently playing for the Milwaukee Admirals in the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Nashville Predators of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Los Angeles Kings in the fifth-round of the 2010 NHL Entry Draft.
